d.ko: The train you took, piercing the night sky and galloping under the stars, was refreshing-it was really a great value trip. In the solo journey under the refreshing night breeze, I met casual passengers and the loving and loving flight attendants.
d.en: The train you took, piercing the night sky and galloping under the stars, was refreshing-it was really a great value trip. In the solo journey under the refreshing night breeze, I met casual passengers and the loving and loving flight attendants.
d.zh: 乘坐的列车，划破夜空，飞驰在星空之下，令人心旷神怡——这可真是场超值之旅。舒爽夜风吹拂下的随心独旅中，我邂逅了随性的乘客，可人怜爱的乘务员。以及……猫耳少女？这场旅行，究竟会在她身上，留下了些什么呢？
